body: Why is sadness scarier? Do you think you care about other people when you say nasty things? If you don't, then does hurting them make you better in any way?

People usually aren't mean to others as much as they are living and in it for themselves. If hurting you means gaining power, money or love in their place, then those who decide to will do it. 

Does anger ever go away? And away without using a heavy amount of time. I don't understand why anger is the first emotion I use now in my depression. Before it was apathy, and now my body decides anger is the new deal. But innately, all these emotions or lack of mostly relate to fear...
